title: Search Insert Position
summary: Return where a target is in a sorted array, or the index where it would be inserted to keep the array sorted.

tests.explain: 6 is already in the array, at index 2.
5 belongs between 4 and 6. Inserting it at index 2 keeps the array sorted (6 and 9 shift right).
12 is larger than every element, so it goes at the very end: index 4, which is nums.length.

hints: Both cases ask the same question: what is the first index whose value is greater than or equal to the target?
Search the range [0, nums.length], including the position just past the end, because the target may belong after every element.
With lo = 0 and hi = nums.length, loop while lo < hi: if nums[mid] < target the answer is to the right (lo = mid + 1), otherwise mid could be the answer (hi = mid). Return lo.

complexity.time: O(log n): the candidate range halves every step
